punchList.where: src/components/exhibit/ground/engine/GroundProvider.tsx:104-138 (deep-link re-scroll, 6 retries x 300ms); verified failing live on cold loads of #a3-flood and #ch4
punchList.what: The round-1 deep-link fix is racy. The retry loop gives up after about 1.8 seconds while lazy scenes are still expanding the document from roughly 1,843px to 45,500px, so cold loads land mid-hydration and drift. Measured live, #a3-flood rested at scrollY 0 with its target at 17,968px, and #ch4 ended near the page bottom with the chapter 28,430px above the viewport. The area permalink and chapter anchors, the exhibit's declared shareable unit, deliver recipients to the wrong room in exactly the cold-load case that sharing creates. Dev chunk loading amplified the delay, but a mid-range phone on cellular hits the same window.
punchList.fix: Replace the fixed retry count with layout-quiescence detection, the pattern Spine.tsx:44 already proves. A ResizeObserver on document.body re-runs scrollIntoView whenever scrollHeight changes while the hash target exists, stands down permanently on the first user wheel, touch, or keydown (the cancel plumbing exists), and caps around 10 to 15 seconds. Add a throttled cold-load deep-link scenario to the verify suite so it cannot regress silently.

punchList.where: src/components/exhibit/ground/scenes/Receipt.tsx:185-188 (mount-only sessionStorage read) and :138-141 (hit-state copy); a6-receipt, both viewports
punchList.what: The finale receipt is wrong on both of its paths. In a single continuous visit, the designed primary path, the mount-only storage read runs at page hydration before the visitor has done the Act 0 lookup, so the reprise never fires and the card asks for device location a second time against its own line that it uses location once. And a visitor who skipped Act 0 and runs the lookup fresh at the receipt gets a card claiming the grade was kept from an earlier lookup that never happened; the stored and fresh paths render the identical sentence. On a page whose ethic is saying exactly what the record supports, the one line about the visitor's own record is false half the time.
punchList.fix: Re-read storedGround() when the receipt step activates, via an effect keyed on activeIndex from useGround or a window CustomEvent that LocateScene dispatches on a successful hit, keeping the mount read for reload and deep-link arrivals. Track how the hit arrived in the state union and render the earlier-lookup line only on the stored path, with a neutral line ('The grade the surveyors filed on the ground under you.') on the fresh path.

ideas.idea: Close the memorial chapter on the record's line of refusal. After 'The record counts the dead. It names neither; one was a child of six.', add one quiet sourced sentence from the commission's own text, 'Only two of the forty Negro families bombed have moved' (already cached in bombings.json contextQuotes.forty-families), optionally with Binga's verbatim 'I will not run. The race is at stake and not myself.'
ideas.why: Standing in front of descendants, the chapter currently leaves only victimhood and impunity, and the record itself holds the staying. It is the Legacy Museum move, dignity drawn from the primary source, zero new claims, and it respects the unnamed-dead rule since Binga is a named target the commission itself names.

Under the a6-sum caption, one line naming each persistent mark with its date (cession line 1833, 32 bombings 1917 to 1921, Hansberry house 1940, renewal area 1955, East Woodlawn 2026), plus two micro-captions on the map itself, '1917-1921' beside the bombing cluster and '2026' beside the enlarged rust ring.

Every item is already drawn and registry-dated, so the key converts 'every mark you watched' from an assertion into a checkable inventory at the exact frame that will circulate as a screenshot, and it completes the sum-state and today-ring punch items rather than adding scope.

In the same run, open the study room from the flood link, close via Escape and via the button, and assert scrollY unchanged with focus returned.

summary: Round 2 confirms the round-1 waves genuinely landed. All eight lenses verified the fulcrum built end to end (the GradeFlood filing-order re-ink, the A-11 and D-106 verbatim pair with highlighted sentences and filing dates, the corpus fact lines, a live area tap with a labeled select fallback and Study Room doors), the memorial chapter honored (target names as primary cells, 32 fanned-out marks with the Binga cluster reading as a cluster, the child's line on the fatal row, the advisory remounted with a working skip, the 1917 to 1921 span with the three-years-and-eight-months takeaway, the pace sentence, the commission's square in its own words, 2 arrests and no convictions), the chrome finished (register baseline, ticks, initials and riding year, an untruncated rail with the Entry N of 11 counter, desktop width used, the spine turning exactly at ch6, sr-only focus traps gone), and the copy surgery held (Hanchett restated to loans 1945 to 1959, Wells at the Haitian Building and moved to the fair chapter, the charge tail, 'The plan goes federal', overture signposts, climb dollars off-axis with multiples waypoints, Two Buyers reconciled at $71,027, the receipt carrying area id, filing date, sheet excerpt and copy link, the basement photo cut under the data-absence rule, the colophon wall plate, rust split from grade D). What remains splits into four small waves. First, four p1s, each a one-file fix. The deep-link retry loses its race to hydration, the study-room close teleports readers 23,000px to the colophon, the receipt never reprises in a continuous visit and claims an earlier lookup that may not exist, and the docket's framing sentence invents an appendix the 1922 report does not have. Second, the present-day payoff. The sum caption claims marks the citywide frame does not show (four lenses), citywide marks render near one pixel, and the today ring is a nameless 5px speck anchored to a label offset, so the 2026 half of the thesis is asserted rather than shown. Third, twice-skipped round-1 residue. The riot post still rides the docket under a 1917 cursor (three lenses), the covenant weld and the dropped white-run qualifier survive, the ch9 head still disagrees with the register bar on the contract era (four lenses), Baldwin's attribution stays off-system, the apostrophe pass missed the TSX and machines.json, and the SCF national scope missed the charge card. Fourth, a polish pass of label halos, flood tap reliability, dagger tap targets, the sheet-card occlusion, docket row order, and two batched copy items. Nothing in this round's list contradicts the deliberate decisions on the covenant layer, the unnamed dead, the no-deflator rule, the label-carries-the-layer fallback, or the as-filed shorthand. The collective estimate across lenses is one to two days of surgical work plus one throttled production smoke, then floor.
floorable: Four of eight lenses would floor the exhibit now. The curator floors it outright, naming the present-day payoff (the 5px rust speck and the sum caption's overclaim) as the single remaining gap. The fresh visitor floors it on content, withholding full confidence only until a throttled production smoke proves the scroll engine never presents the frozen 1940 page and the rust mark becomes findable at 390px. The visual lens floors it on craft grounds, calling the round-1 chrome debt genuinely paid, with a day of resting-state seam fixes remaining. The creative lens floors it except for one gap, the deep-link cold-load race that delivers shared links to the wrong room. Four say close but not yet. The historian is a morning away, wanting the covenant weld split, the white-run qualifier restored, the sum caption made literally true, and the riot post moved. The interaction lens blocks on its two p1s, the study-room teleport and the dead receipt reprise, both one-file fixes, and would floor with those plus deep-link quiescence. The humanizer would not floor today because two rebuilt flagship scenes state something wrong in visitor-facing text, the D-106 caption garble and the receipt's false earlier-lookup line, plus the charge card's federal-survey collision, and would floor with those three sentences fixed. Sensitivity is one sentence away, refusing to floor a memorial chapter whose first paragraph makes a source claim (the invented appendix) that fails a five-minute check, with the riot post move as the companion fix. No lens asked for another full wave, and every blocking item named in a verdict appears in the punch list.
